notes: All clips cut from 360p (format 18) because the web client only offered SABR streams; downloads went through yt-dlp with --extractor-args youtube:player_client=android. Every clip below was checked on contact sheets, a 2 fps zoom sheet, and a full-size proof frame. The quote field is empty throughout: no audio was transcribed, and none of these windows depends on speech.
